title: An area's texture pattern animations: res/field/maps/pattern_animations/<n>/animations.json
description: File n of ARCID_AREA_ANIME_PAT (a/0/6/9), the pack of the areas whose pattern_animation is n, which FieldTerrainAnimator_LoadTexPat loads (field_ground_anime.c). Each texture is <name>.png beside this file, an indexed PNG of its palette's indices, and each palette <first name>.pal, a JASC palette. tools/data/map_pattern_animation_data.py packs it.

animations.description: The pack's animations, at most FIELD_TERRAIN_TEXPAT_ANIMATION_MAX: each a GFBTP and its texture set (BTX0)

length.description: How many frames the animation lasts before it loops (GFBTPController's frameCount)

textures.description: The texture set's textures in its order, each <name>.png

name.description: The texture's name, which its palette's is with _pl; a target draws over the area's texture of the name of the first of its textures

palettes.description: The texture set's palettes in its order, each a list of the names that share one palette's colors, <first name>.pal

targets.description: The textures of the area's texture set that the animation draws over, each its key frames from frame 0: from each key frame on to the next, the target shows the key's texture

texture.description: The texture it shows, by name

palette.description: Its palette by name, which the code doesn't read; when left out the one at the texture's index
